what: The image and music engines built with ggml's tiled CPU matrix multiply (GGML_LLAMAFILE=ON, llamafile's sgemm), as the chat engine is (D-030)
machine: Cloud test VM: 4 cores (Xeon, AVX-512 with FP16 and AMX), 15.7 GB RAM; native builds; files in the OS cache (warm)

picture.model: SD-Turbo, sd_turbo-f16-q8_0.gguf, 512x512, 1 step, no guidance, seed 42, --rng cpu

cold_start_before_s.note: the VM's disk read the 1.9 GB file at about 30 MB/s; not repeated after

picture_quality.how: the same six prompts, seed 11 and starting noise as bench/results/cloud/2026-11-07-images-kera-vs-diffusers.json, against Hugging Face diffusers in float32 (the reference)

8_bit_file_sd_turbo_f16_q8_0.note: the 8-bit file's own rounding sets how close it gets to the reference; the new build is as close as the old

picture_quality.verdict: as close to the reference as before (closer with the full-precision file): the same quality

music.model: ACE-Step 1.5 smallest set (5Hz LM 0.6B Q8_0, v1.5 turbo Q4_K_M, VAE BF16), 10 s instrumental, ACESTEP_THREADS=4

sound_quality.verdict: the same song with a small difference, ten times smaller than another seed's; no reference code was run for music
